summary: Full-stack service marketplace connecting customers with local service providers through seamless booking workflows.
challenge: Local service discovery and booking are often fragmented, lacking reliable provider verification and structured scheduling workflows.
solution: Delivered a centralized platform featuring role-based portals for seamless booking, service listing management, and administrative provider verification.
contributions: Built the responsive React frontend with customer and provider portals
Designed protected REST APIs using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB
Implemented role-based authentication and security with Clerk
Developed automated test suites using Jest and Supertest
